title: Not what I was looking for ...
text:
Not what I was looking for .... These dishes are EXTREMELY SMALL. If your intension is to use them as dipping sauce plates, a standard sushi roll would barely fit, if the dish had soy sauce & wasabi in it already. It's probably too small even for a child & their chicken nuggets. I'm sure there is a great application for these, they just weren't for me.

They are also melamine, which I'm not always comfortable putting in the microwave and cab tend to stain with some foods. I ended up returning them for some larger ceramic versions that were not too much more per plate.

product_metadata.title: Soy Sauce Dish, pack of 20
features: Perfect for dipping sauces like sweet and sour or mustard and soy
2 2/3 inches wide, what a perfect size!
Melamine plastic is a hard plastic and is almost unbreakable under normal use!
